name: Advanced Workload Distribution Schemes
definition: A category of methods to distribute rendering workload between a fast GPU (raycasting/image warping) and a slow GPU (raycasting) to improve visual quality beyond strict node assignment, by replacing some image warping with raycasting.
summary: Advanced Workload Distribution Schemes dynamically shift rendering tasks between fast and slow GPUs to replace low-quality image warping with high-quality raycasting, adapting to scene interest rather than using rigid separation planes.
